levels.surface: الحسن بن عبد الله بن محمد بن عيسى

notes: «عمن ذكره» is a gap the text marks itself: an unnamed link, left unfilled (rule 8)
«وَ عَنِ الْأَصْبَغِ عَنْ زَاذَانَ» is read in sequence (the «و» joins two links, not two routes); another reading would put المنهال and الأصبغ as co-transmitters, which the text's «عن» does not show

«سَمِعْتُ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ (ع) فِي الرَّحْبَةِ يَقُولُ» names the Imam in the words after the chain, so he is the last link, imam_in_text (owner ruling 2); «الحسن بن محبوب» and «أبيه» in the opening are the chain's own links
